body:
Stoned Forever
I have tried all of the synthetic Cannabinoids that I've had access to, including JWH-018, JWH-073, and CP-55,945. I've also grown and smoked Cannabis from some of the best seed available on the 'net, so I have a large amount of experience with which to make comparisons.
So it was a happy day when I logged on to my favorite RC vendor's site and saw a new product, CP-47,497, offered for sale. I immediately placed an order and less than 2 weeks later, from half-way 'round the world, came my newest synthetic Cannabinoid.
I weighed out 2 mg.'s on my scale and tried to transfer this to my glass pipe. Unfortunately, even though it is a fine white powder, it seems to want to stick to everything except the pipe
it seems to want to stick to everything except the pipe
. In the end approx. 1 1/2 mg. were vaporized in 2 hits. Both hits were held as long as possible, the taste being much like that of CP-55,940.
Onset was immediate, before the first hit was exhaled, my head and body felt the familiar Cannabiniod rush. The space between my ears, behind my forehead, instantly relaxed, mellow. Music appreciation was definately enhanced, as I put on the Ipod full of Johnny Winter and proceeded outside to weed my garden of entheogenic plants.
Time seemed to pass quickly, 2 hours went by in 15 minutes. Munchies were setting in and I ate a large lunch. Still feeling stoned and a little groggy, I laid back in the chair to listen to more Johnny.
Three hours later I woke up, still stoned. After eating again, the buzz faded until, after 8 hours, I seemed to return to sobriety. That night I slept well.
Summary : I was well-rested before trying this, but it really knocked me out. I never take 3 hour naps in the middle of the day. Next time I will try half as much, maybe a little less than 1 mg. IMO this is much stronger than CP-55,940, though its effects and duration most closely match CP-55,940.
